newsitem.title: FINLAND: Baltic Ice- Fast ice forming in southern bays.
newsitem.headline: Baltic Ice- Fast ice forming in southern bays.

text.p: Fast ice was forming in Swedish bays south of Stockholm while ice levels were little changed in the Gulf of Bothnia and the Gulf of Finland, the Finnish Institute of Marine Research said on Monday.

In its twice-weekly report, all Finnish restrictions were unchanged. An institute official said by telehone that the restriction for Swedish ports in the northern part of the Gulf of Bothnia was IB and a minimum of 2,000 deadweight tonnes.
The restriction for St Petersburg was Russian Ice class 13 and a minimum 2,000 horse-power engine, he said.

Five icebreakers were on station near St Petersburg and Vyborg in the eastern Gulf of Finland, three in the northern end of the Gulf of Bothnia, three in the middle of the Gulf of Bothnia and one outside Parnu in the Gulf of Riga.
